notes.title: Daily rewards, plus other new features
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Added the Daily Rewards fairy, located in the Tavern basement, who rewards the player for completing certain tasks every day.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Orb Transformer fairy, who lets the player transform one type of orb into another type.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the large board game due to file corruption issue, and replaced it with a better board, the first of many, the Ice Forest board. Features include a Witch who plays a game of chance with the player, and a Temple that contains a secret (that has yet to be added, sorry lol).[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified potion recipes to have all potions only need two ingredients[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed and updated help menu to include all up-to-date descriptions of stats, among other things. Please view the help menu if you are ever stuck in the game.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Mac Version
notes.notes: [p]Just added a MacOS version of the game. Still trying to figure out the odds and ends, I'm not sure if it works or shows up... but I will get that straightened out asap.[/p]
